# The Free Station Charter
The following is an agreement binding all member states of Freeport Camelot, as of now signatories of the Free Station Charter, detailing the rights each member holds as well as the laws they must follow. All members of these signatory factions are now considered Residents of Freeport Camelot.
From hereon; members of signatory parties may likewise be referred to as signatories themselves.
# Section 1 - Basic rights
[color=gold]1.1[/color] - All members reserve the right to independent diplomacy. No one signatory may determine the stance of others.
[color=gold]1.2[/color] - All members reserve the right to come and go as they please. No ships belonging to signatories of this charter may be denied entry or leave from the station. This right may be [bold]revoked[/bold] in the following circumstances:
- [color=orange]1.2.1[/color] - Reasonable evidence points to a signatory or individual's ship being taken over by an outside party.
- [color=orange]1.2.2[/color] - The signatory or individual has [bold]violated this Charter[/bold].
- [color=orange]1.2.3[/color] - The ship's pilot is determined to have lost independent use of their mental faculties.
[color=gold]1.3[/color] - All members reserve the right to freely use all facilities located in the central segment of the station.
[color=gold]1.4[/color] - All members reserve the right to private and exclusive access to [bold]their[/bold] segments of the station.
[color=gold]1.5[/color] - Leaders of signatory factions possess the right to grant Freeport Residency to any they choose.
- [color=orange]1.5.1[/color] - Individuals who obtain Residency in this way are granted the same rights and expected to follow the same laws as all other signatories.
# Section 2 - Stationside laws For the purposes of this section, stationside is defined as any area, station or ship [color=red][bold]within 3 kilometers of Freeport Camelot[/color][/bold].
[color=gold]2.1[/color] - Signatories of this charter must, to the best of their ability, uphold and ensure the station's security and continued functionality.
[color=gold]2.2[/color] - Signatories of this charter must not engage in hostilities with each other on or within [bold]3 kilometers[/bold] of the station.
- [color=orange]2.2.1[/color] - Referring to clause [color=orange]3.1.1[/color], conflict of interest, [bold]no signatory may act on aforementioned clause[/bold] under any circumstance while [bold]within stationside's jurisdiction[/bold].
[color=gold]2.3[/color] - Signatories of this charter may, [bold]in the event of lack of communication[/bold], forcibly detach ships belonging to other signatories docked to their segment of the station at their discretion.
[color=gold]2.4[/color] - Signatories of this charter must, to the best of their ability, [bold]attempt to rescue any fellow individuals in a dangerous situation[/bold] on or within 3 kilometers of the station.
- [color=orange]2.4.1[/color] - The only exception to this clause be the rescue of said signatory present on a faction's opposing third party. See [color=orange]3.1.1[/color] for details.
[color=gold]2.5[/color] - Signatories of this charter [bold]may not[/bold] demand payment of any kind in exchange for performing their duties pretaining the station's security or the wellbeing of it's inhabitants.
[color=gold]2.6[/color] - Signatories of this charter may not, [bold]barring specific circumstances[/bold], invade another signatory's segment of the station without their permission.
- [color=orange]2.6.1[/color] - The need to recover or otherwise access a ship belonging to the signatory is an [bold]exception[/bold] to this.
[color=gold]2.7[/color] - Signatories of this charter may not, without permission, take resources, equipment or machinery located in another signatory's segment of the station.
- [color=orange]2.7.1[/color] - An exception is recovery of equipment or machinery clearly belonging to and or patented by a signatory located in another's segment, [bold]barring situations when said equipment was willingly given away[/bold].
- [color=orange]2.8[/color] - Signatories of this charter may not take actions risking the station's safety or integrity without prior discussion with other signatories currently present in the sector.
- [color=orange]2.9[/color] - In emergencies threatening the station, laws regarding private areas of the station [bold]may be relaxed[/bold] to allow for faster response to dangerous situations.
- [color=orange]2.10[/color] - In emergencies threatening the station, the highest ranking official [bold]among all signatories present[/bold] will take charge. In the event of two highest officials from two different member factions being present, they must decide between themselves as fast as possible who should take charge.
# Section 3 - Spaceside laws For the purposes of this section, spaceside is determined as any area, station or ship [color=red][bold]further than 3 kilometers from Freeport Camelot[/bold][/color].
[color=gold]3.1[/color] - Signatories may not commit acts of piracy or wage battle against ships flown under the flag of another signatory.
- [color=orange]3.1.1[/color] - Conflict of interests may present an exception - Should one signatory provide services to a third party in opposition to another signatories employer and/or allied party the following charter will allow conflict. Alternatively should any signatory prevent another signatory from conflict with a hostile third party in any way this charter allows conflict.
- [color=orange]3.1.2[/color] - Following such conflict of interests being resolved for any reason, all hostilities between signatories must [bold]immediately cease[/bold] and a joint attempt at recovery and revival of the dead and injured must be made.
[color=gold]3.2[/color] - Signatories receiving another's distress calls [bold]must respond[/bold] and provide assistance, provided they are in a position to do so successfully.
[color=gold]3.3[/color] - Signatories should not, [bold]barring extreme circumstances[/bold], leak any information pretaining to another signatory to outside parties.
# Section 4 - Violation of the Free Station Charter The following section is for clarity under the circumstance that an individual or group is to break the Charter's agreement to the dismay of one or more signatory.
[color=gold]4.1[/color] - Any individual found violating the Charter should be held accountable over the signatory at whole.
[color=gold]4.2[/color] - No expulsion from the Charter and its rights last more than one full cycle[bold]*[/bold].
[color=gold]4.3[/color] - The accountable individual must be sentenced by all active parties within the Charter at the time of violation.
- [color=orange]4.3.1[/color] - Should one active signatory remain radio silent or otherwise their vote is considered abstained.
- [color=orange]4.3.2[/color] - No punishment given to the accountable individual should lead to further breach of the Charter in any form.
[color=gold]4.4[/color] - Should an entire signatory party unanimously act in opposition to the charter; their rights should be [bold]suspended*[/bold] and any access to Freeport Camelot barred until one cycle[bold]*[/bold] is fulfilled.
- [color=orange]4.4.1[/color] - Regardless of the severity; all actions taken by the guilty party and its subsequent sentence [bold]must[/bold] be a unanimous vote between all active parties at the time of the violation(s).
[color=gold]4.5[/color] - Any actions taken by an accusing signatory parties head of operation that seeks to suspend[bold]*[/bold] an accountable individual and/or guilty signatory party must contact their relevant oversight[bold]*[/bold].
# OOC Clarification (*) (OOC = Out of Character)
Cycle* refers to one in-game round duration.
Oversight* refers to admin intervention.
Suspension* refers to a faction role ban.
